scientific_purpose: Measure actual per-objective layer gradients and read-only optimizer-direction algebra in all 15 original frozen ME106 models on authentic FIT observations only.

protocol.checkpoints: All ME106 balanced, point_guard, point_strong seeds106001..106005; unchanged original hashes
protocol.cohort: UCI501 2013-2014 FIT only; no REPORT or protected 2016-2017 numerical conversion
protocol.rng: default_rng(107000+context+1000*repeat+(10000 if gap else 0)); same selection/masking across all models
protocol.augmentation: Unchanged ME102 causal FIT masking; population gap denotes natural PM2.5-gap origins, not every channel missing. Reconstruction targets exist only for actually recorded hidden current readings.
protocol.measurements: Five unweighted objective gradients; weighted norms; ten pairwise cosines in 13 exhaustive parameter blocks and whole model; point/NLL cosine by observed/missing target channel; floor activity; global point/aux projection; hypothetical next direction with saved AdamW moments, clipping, group rates and decay.
protocol.analysis: Descriptive fractions, medians by history/population. Undefined zero-gradient cosine=null. No significance, independent predictive improvement, causal attribution, or new gate-pass claim.
protocol.optimizer: No optimizer.step or weight update; read-only FP64 analytic hypothetical next direction. It is not an actual training step or a measured finite-step loss change.
protocol.stopping: Exactly one original no-fit panel plus replay; no parameter/loss/gate tuning. Any subsequent training requires a new frozen protocol.
